title: celosia cristata var. castrensis
intro:
Celosia cristata var. castrensis, commonly known as Woolflower or Plume Celosia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is valued for its vibrant, feathery plumes and is often used as an ornamental in gardens. Celosia cristata var. castrensis has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function.
